instruction: Open a 4K HDR Amazon Prime Video movie that you have downloaded for offline use in VLC.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Amazon Prime Video downloads are encrypted with Widevine DRM and stored in a proprietary format that can only be played within the Prime Video app. VLC cannot access or decrypt these offline downloads.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: Widevine DRM - Amazon Prime offline downloads are encrypted and app-locked

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Amazon Prime Video offline downloads are DRM-protected and cannot be played in VLC
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate semantic choice for tasks that are technically impossible to complete
Explanation accurately describes the technical limitation: Widevine DRM encryption makes the content app-locked to Amazon Prime Video
Source documentation (VLC's own DRM documentation) confirms VLC cannot handle DRM-protected content
No verification logic is needed because the task fundamentally cannot be completed regardless of user actions
